# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by docs/tools/gen_cli_reference.py from the Typer application in
src/brandsentinel/cli.py. Do not edit by hand: run the generator. -->

Generated from the command definitions in
[`src/brandsentinel/cli.py`](../../src/brandsentinel/cli.py). For what the commands are for and
which ones are safe where, see [Getting started](../guide/getting-started.md) and
[Reproducibility](../guide/reproducibility.md).

Every command accepts the global option `-c/--config PATH` (before the command name):
the configuration file. Without it, `$BRANDSENTINEL_CONFIG` is used, then the built-in
defaults (which put the data directory at `./data`). `$BRANDSENTINEL_DATA_DIR` overrides
`data_dir` from either source. Commands that open a store act on the configured
`data_dir`, and refuse to run as root or with none of those three, so always pass an
explicit `-c` outside a scratch checkout.

**Commands that open a store write to it, including inspection commands** such as
`status` and `cases list`. They create a missing store, apply migrations and sweep
orphan blobs ([Storage](../concepts/storage.md)). **Only `run` and `registry collect`
check the account**. The other store-opening commands accept any non-root account, and
commands that do not open a store still run as root
([Security model](../concepts/security.md#which-commands-enforce-it)). Production use is
owner-operated, as the service account
([Deployment](../operations/deployment.md#production-cli-operations)).


## Commands

| Command | Summary |
|---|---|
| `analyze` | Collect enrichment facts for one domain and print them. No case is created (RDAP answers are cached for reuse). |
| `cases label` | Record an analyst label (per question, or the overall verdict) for evaluation. Labels never change the policy decision. |
| `cases list` | List cases, highest priority first. |
| `cases rescore` | Rebuild each case's evidence bundle from stored facts and score it with the current registry and policy (for example after a policy or registry change). Nothing is fetched. |
| `cases show` | Show a case: priority, reasons with evidence, and the observed evidence. |
| `eval` | Run the model evaluation. [planned: M8] |
| `export csv` | Export cases as CSV (stable columns; formula triggers neutralized). |
| `match` | Match names against the registry and print one JSON result per line. |
| `proxy` | Run the egress proxy (inside its container; see docker/compose.yaml). |
| `registry collect` | Build the reference corpus from confirmed reference assets and pages (verified HTTPS on confirmed official domains only). Images are hashed in the media sandbox, which outside lab mode runs only under the dedicated account. |
| `registry corpus` | List the reference corpus as matching will use it, and any entry the current registry no longer vouches for. |
| `registry validate` | Validate the registry and report counts by status and tier. |
| `replay` | Re-ingest the discovery raw log (idempotent: nothing is duplicated). |
| `report` | Write self-contained HTML analyst reports (escaped, strict CSP, no live links). |
| `run` | Run discovery (CertStream, dnstwist) and the pipeline until interrupted. |
| `sandbox check` | Run the sandbox preflight: account, rootless runtime and (with a direct-egress probe container) the sandbox network. Exits 1 if any check fails. |
| `sandbox selftest` | Run a worker in a real sandbox container and check its gate (media: hashing, OCR, QR, bomb and format rejection, no network; browser: after the network check, Chromium's own sandbox, an unprivileged worker, and no direct route for a browser without a proxy). Exits 1 if any check fails. |
| `sandbox sweep` | Remove every sandbox container labelled with this instance (normally done automatically at startup, before job leases are recovered). |
| `status` | Show store, queue, artifact and raw-log status. |
| `submit` | Submit URLs or domains for analysis (never suppressed). |
| `sweep` | Run dnstwist sweeps now, ignoring the schedule. |
| `version` | Print the BrandSentinel version. |

## `brandsentinel analyze`

Collect enrichment facts for one domain and print them. No case is created (RDAP answers are cached for reuse).

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DOMAIN` | argument | Domain name to analyze. |
| `--passive` / `--fetch` | flag | DNS, RDAP, TLS and similarity only (default), or also a static fetch. |


## `brandsentinel cases label`

Record an analyst label (per question, or the overall verdict) for evaluation. Labels never change the policy decision.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CASE_ID` | argument | Case number. |
| `--question` | option (str) | Decision question (see --help of the evaluation). |
| `--value` | option (str) | yes, no or unsure. |
| `--verdict` | option (str) | Overall: abusive, suspicious, benign, unrelated, unsure. |
| `--by` | option (str) | Who is labelling. |


## `brandsentinel cases list`

List cases, highest priority first.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--priority` / `-p` | option (str) | P1..P4 or no_action (repeatable). |
| `--category` | option (str) | Category (repeatable). |
| `--label` | option (str) | Context label, e.g. editorial_or_critical. |
| `--source` | option (str) | Discovery source: certstream, dnstwist, manual. |
| `--strength` | option (str) | Match strength: strong or weak. |
| `--status` | option (str) | Case status, e.g. open. |
| `--since` | option (str) | Cases created on or after YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). |
| `--limit` | option (int) | At most this many cases. |


## `brandsentinel cases rescore`

Rebuild each case's evidence bundle from stored facts and score it with the current registry and policy (for example after a policy or registry change). Nothing is fetched.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CASE_IDS`... | argument, optional | Case numbers. |
| `--all` | flag | Every open case. |
| `--reextract` | flag | First re-run the extractors over each case's stored page (offline). |


## `brandsentinel cases show`

Show a case: priority, reasons with evidence, and the observed evidence.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CASE_ID` | argument | Case number. |
| `--json` | flag | Print the scored bundle and policy result as JSON. |


## `brandsentinel eval`

Run the model evaluation. [planned: M8]

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ARGS`... | argument, optional |  |


## `brandsentinel export csv`

Export cases as CSV (stable columns; formula triggers neutralized).

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--out` / `-o` | option (path), default `-` | CSV file to write, or - for stdout. |
| `--priority` / `-p` | option (str) | P1..P4 or no_action (repeatable). |
| `--category` | option (str) | Category (repeatable). |
| `--label` | option (str) | Context label, e.g. editorial_or_critical. |
| `--source` | option (str) | Discovery source: certstream, dnstwist, manual. |
| `--strength` | option (str) | Match strength: strong or weak. |
| `--status` | option (str) | Case status, e.g. open. |
| `--since` | option (str) | Cases created on or after YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). |
| `--limit` | option (int) | At most this many cases. |


## `brandsentinel match`

Match names against the registry and print one JSON result per line.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAMES`... | argument, optional | Domain names to match. |
| `--file` / `-f` | option (path) | File with one name per line. |
| `--registry` | option (path) | Registry file (default: config). |


## `brandsentinel proxy`

Run the egress proxy (inside its container; see docker/compose.yaml).

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--listen` | option (str) | ip:port to listen on (repeatable). |
| `--log-level` | option (str), default `INFO` | Log level. |


## `brandsentinel registry collect`

Build the reference corpus from confirmed reference assets and pages (verified HTTPS on confirmed official domains only). Images are hashed in the media sandbox, which outside lab mode runs only under the dedicated account.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--brand` | option (str) | Only this brand id (repeatable). |


## `brandsentinel registry corpus`

List the reference corpus as matching will use it, and any entry the current registry no longer vouches for.


## `brandsentinel registry validate`

Validate the registry and report counts by status and tier.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--path` | option (path) | Registry file (default: config). |
| `--overlay` | option (path) | Also merge this overlay (e.g. registry/lab-overlay.yaml). |
| `--legacy-dir` | option (path), default `legacy` | Check coverage of the legacy scripts' inputs. |


## `brandsentinel replay`

Re-ingest the discovery raw log (idempotent: nothing is duplicated).

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--since-hours` | option (float) | Only records logged in the last N hours. |


## `brandsentinel report`

Write self-contained HTML analyst reports (escaped, strict CSP, no live links).

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CASE_IDS`... | argument, optional | Case numbers. |
| `--index` | flag | Also write index.html. |
| `--out` | option (path) | Output directory (default: <data_dir>/reports). |


## `brandsentinel run`

Run discovery (CertStream, dnstwist) and the pipeline until interrupted.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--certstream` / `--no-certstream` | flag | Consume CertStream (config default). |
| `--dnstwist` / `--no-dnstwist` | flag | Run scheduled dnstwist sweeps. |
| `--enrich` / `--no-enrich` | flag | Run passive enrichment (config default). |
| `--fetch` / `--no-fetch` | flag | Run the hardened static fetch (config default). |
| `--duration` | option (float) | Stop after this many seconds (default: run forever). |
| `--until-idle` | flag | Also stop once no work is left (rechecks not yet due stay queued). Needs CertStream and dnstwist off; --duration still bounds the run. |
| `--log-level` | option (str), default `INFO` | Log level. |


## `brandsentinel sandbox check`

Run the sandbox preflight: account, rootless runtime and (with a direct-egress probe container) the sandbox network. Exits 1 if any check fails.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--network` / `--no-network` | flag | Also check the sandbox network. |
| `--strict` | flag | Also fail on warnings (a check that passed only through the developer override). The dedicated service account must pass this (SP1). |


## `brandsentinel sandbox selftest`

Run a worker in a real sandbox container and check its gate (media: hashing, OCR, QR, bomb and format rejection, no network; browser: after the network check, Chromium's own sandbox, an unprivileged worker, and no direct route for a browser without a proxy). Exits 1 if any check fails.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ROLE` | argument | Worker to test: media or browser. |


## `brandsentinel sandbox sweep`

Remove every sandbox container labelled with this instance (normally done automatically at startup, before job leases are recovered).


## `brandsentinel status`

Show store, queue, artifact and raw-log status.


## `brandsentinel submit`

Submit URLs or domains for analysis (never suppressed).

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TARGETS`... | argument | URLs or domain names. |
| `--render` | flag | Request a browser render for the case's next undecided analysis round (budget: browser.analyst_renders_per_day; never bypasses the static-fetch and official-domain checks). |


## `brandsentinel sweep`

Run dnstwist sweeps now, ignoring the schedule.

| Parameter | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TARGETS`... | argument, optional | Registry dnstwist targets (default: all). |


## `brandsentinel version`

Print the BrandSentinel version.
